name: Salajeet [Mineral Pitch, Red Sage]
pharmacology_description: Salajeet is a unique combination of Mineral Pitch (Silajit), Sage (Salvia haematodes) and others natural ingredients. It enhances the activity of insulin, which is beneficial for diabetic patients. It is effective in leucorrhoea and polyuria. Salajeet acts as a powerful antioxidant, it provides protection against degenerative diseases such as heart disease, diabetes and arthritis. It also acts general tonic and effective in spermatorrhoea.
dosage_description: 1 tablet twice daily or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in proper dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place, protect from light.
